messages.subject: shiny app becomes unresponsive
parts:
Hey,

I have made couple of apps for teaching students. Some students reported that link is unresponsive and some students say the page becomes gray after a couple of minute.

Is this happening because multiple students are using the app same time? or app is heavy in output size.

for example explore this one for factor analysis -   https://wordcloud.shinyapps.io/factorapp/

I am also attaching a csv file to test this app.

P.S. I also tested it. most of the time it works fine. but i have faced same issues as well.

Thanks

Aashish

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] shiny app becomes unresponsive
parts:
Hi Aashish,
Can you send the output of your showLogs() call please?  It would be good to get a feel for the errors that are being outputted.  If I had to guess, I would guess that your app consumes some significant amount of memory per session and is getting killed off.  If that is the case, you can upgrade the instance size to a large or xlarge.

Best,
Tareef
